events.title: THE ECOLOGIK INSTITUTE — Wildlife Detective: Using Camera Traps to Monitor and Analyze Animals in the Wild
events.description: Ever wonder how scientists monitor animals when we can't be near them? Join us as we look at real camera trap footage from Cabrillo National Monument and identify the animal species we see! Afterwards, we'll analyze our findings and put together an ecosystem web of life!
